body.zh: 玉海舰队的旗舰本身就是一条建筑树。
body.en: The Jade Sea Fleet's flagship is itself a building tree.

body.zh: 引雷之峰、輝山锻冶场、枪术道场、神兽宫、灵道社殿，各自解锁独有的加成或兵种。
body.en: Thunder-Drawing Peak, Hikariya Forge, Yari Dojo, Divine Beast Sanctum and the Vim-To Shrine, each with its own bonuses or units.

body.zh: 稻荷神社 → 稻荷大社 → 灵兽神宫。依次解锁稻荷灵狐使者、巫女、麒麟。
body.en: Inari Shrine → Inari Grand Shrine → Divine Beast Sanctuary. Unlocks the Inari Fox Emissary, the Miko and the Kirin in turn.

body.zh: 番所 → 侍所 → 旗本番。依次解锁长枪武士、铁炮武士、雷刃旗本。
body.en: Watch Post → Samurai Hall → Hatamoto Guard. Unlocks Yari Samurai, Teppo Samurai, then Thunderblade Hatamoto.
